Frequently Asked Questions

How old is J.J. Barea?

J.J. Barea is 42 years old.

Where was J.J. Barea born?

J.J. Barea was born in Mayaguez, Puerto Rico.

When was J.J. Barea born?

J.J. Barea was born on June 26, 1984.

How tall is J.J. Barea?

J.J. Barea is 5-10 (178 cm) tall.

How much did J.J. Barea weigh when playing?

J.J. Barea weighed 180 lbs (81 kg) when playing.

Is J.J. Barea in the Hall of Fame?

J.J. Barea is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position did J.J. Barea play?

Point Guard and Shooting Guard.

When did J.J. Barea retire?

J.J. Barea last played in 2020.

What is J.J. Barea's net worth?

J.J. Barea made at least $40,760,477 playing professional basketball.

How much did J.J. Barea make?

J.J. Barea made $4,687,000 in 2014.

What did J.J. Barea average?

J.J. Barea averaged 8.9 points, 2.1 rebounds, and 3.9 assists per game.

How many rings does J.J. Barea have?

J.J. Barea won one championship.

What is J.J. Barea's Instagram account?

J.J. Barea is on Instagram at jjbarea11.

What schools did J.J. Barea attend?

J.J. Barea attended Miami Christian School in Miami, Florida and Northeastern University.

What are J.J. Barea's nicknames?

J.J. is a nickname for J.J. Barea.
